title: Provisioning Advisor: SLA-band controller and right-size telemetry for dedicated fleets
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers running Dedicated fleets ask for predictable throughput guarantees tied to contractual SLAs, while also wanting automated right-sizing suggestions to avoid overprovisioning. Current telemetry is coarse-grained per-pool and lacks SLA-band signals (p95/p99 tail windows per tenant) needed to make safe autoscale and resizing recommendations.

Goal: Build a Provisioning Advisor that: (1) consumes high-cardinality per-tenant telemetry (latency distributions, concurrency, queue depth) and derives SLA-bands; (2) exposes an SLA-band controller that maps target throughput/SLOs to recommended pool sizes and autoscale policies; (3) surfaces right-size recommendations and confidence intervals in Console and as a JSON report for infra automation.

Scope: This ticket covers backend telemetry pipeline changes, the advisor algorithm, a minimal API endpoint for recommendations, and an internal Console endpoint for QA. UI polish / public Console GA is out of scope for this ticket and will be a follow-up.

Non-goals: Changing runtime scheduling kernels or introducing new hardware types. We will assume existing runtime metrics are sufficient once sampled at higher resolution and joined with request-level metadata.
suggested_solution:
1) Extend ingestion pipeline to include per-tenant sliding-window latency histograms (1s granularity, 5m window), concurrent inflight counts, and backlog depth; tag with model_variant and seq_len_bucket. 2) Compute SLA-bands (p50/p90/p95/p99) and a throughput-throughput-variance model for each tenant using an exponential smoothing forecast over 30m/2h windows. 3) Advisor converts SLA target to required GPU slots via an empirical token/sec per-slot profile, applies headroom buffer (configurable by customer tier), and recommends: Resize delta (+/- slots), suggested autoscale min/max, and conservative canary plan (step size/time). 4) Provide /api/v1/dedicated/advisor?tenant=<id>&slo=p95:200ms returning JSON with recommended_pool_size, confidence_pct, suggested_autoscale_policy, and rationale.

Implementation notes: start with offline batch job to validate models before enabling live sampling; default headroom 20% for standard customers, 5% for enterprise; expose feature flag to disable recommendations for customers with custom hardware commitments.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry: per-tenant histograms and inflight metrics are being ingested into metrics-store with 1s granularity and retained for 48h (QA Grafana dashboard exists)
Advisor: API returns recommendation JSON for a sample tenant and SLO that matches offline simulation within 10% of expected slot count
Safety: Advisor includes conservative canary plan and confidence_pct in response
Console: Internal QA page shows recommendations and change impact estimate (monthly cost delta and expected latency improvement)
Documentation: Confluence PRD and runbook with QA steps + rollback plan are published

decisions: Use sliding-window histogram approach vs per-request logging to limit cardinality and billing impact
Prioritize high-spend tenants for full-resolution telemetry; sample others
Advisor will provide conservative canary steps by default (max 10% change per hour) to avoid SLA regressions
Expose headroom as configurable per-customer tier (default 20%)
